title: Lift issue62424 minStartTS oracle to live GC safepoint on authorized testbed

payload.validation_scope: live testbed lift of server minStartTS observer: while transaction-issued ADD INDEX was still running and processlist still exposed its TxnStart, /tidb/server/minstartts advanced past that DDL TxnStart
payload.goal: prove the root minStartTS boundary has the expected cluster-observable effect: server minStartTS is not pinned by a queued DDL session after implicit commit
payload.remaining_gap: GC safe point itself still advances on the normal GC cadence and was not shortened in this testbed; this run proves server minStartTS, not a full 10-minute GC safepoint cycle

name: Live GC safepoint must not be pinned by queued DDL after implicit commit

payload.p_check: The local root-boundary oracle proved ReportMinStartTS must ignore queued DDL sessions with stale CurTxnStartTS.
payload.q_claim: On a live cluster, this should manifest as server minStartTS progress not being pinned by a long DDL session after DDL implicit commit.

boundary.before: a session begins a transaction, then runs a long CREATE/ALTER INDEX so the DDL job is queued after implicit commit
boundary.fault: the DDL session remains visible to observers with stale transaction state while the DDL is running
boundary.after: server minStartTS advances according to real active transactions/internal windows, not the stale DDL session

source_anchors: testbed 8220955 processlist TxnStart for DDL connection 3456123122
etcd /tidb/server/minstartts samples while DDL was still running
side_effects: server minStartTS was not pinned by the queued DDL TxnStart
full GC safepoint remains a broader cadence-dependent observation
payload.consequence: on the fixed testbed build, the user-visible cluster observer did not retain stale DDL transaction state as a minStartTS blocker
payload.experiment_result: GREEN on testbed 8220955 for ADD INDEX over 1048576 rows with slow DDL reorg settings

source_anchors: validated historical fix PR 62607 skips StmtCtx.IsDDLJobInQueue in ReportMinStartTS

evidence.test: live ADD INDEX issued after BEGIN with processlist and etcd minStartTS observer
evidence.oracle: while DDL remains visible with TxnStart, server minStartTS must be able to advance past that DDL TxnStart
evidence.green_observation: sample 16 still had the DDL processlist row, while minStartTS advanced to 467568057116524554; later samples advanced further to 467568066213183509 and 467568072111423519 before the DDL disappeared at sample 48

lessons.selector_worked: The refill target successfully lifted a root-boundary oracle into a live cluster observer by using the exact consumer state path: processlist TxnStart -> InfoSyncer minStartTS -> etcd key.
lessons.control_plane_lesson: Target state must bind runs to obligation_key; selector-level grouping is too coarse once refill targets reuse a validated selector.
lessons.remaining_gap: GC safepoint has a 10m cadence on this testbed and was not shortened, so full safepoint-cycle proof remains broader than this minStartTS lift.
